agent.summary:
Mitigated; both alerts have cleared.

- Frontend had an invalid readiness probe targeting port 40 and nonexistent `/ready`. Restored the previous healthy deployment configuration.
- Accounting’s latency alert included time waiting for Kafka messages. Excluded that idle-wait span; monitored p95 is about 96 ms.

Verified the frontend is ready and homepage/product APIs return HTTP 200.
